framing: Framing (accepted for F5, 2026-10-27; extended for F6, 2026-10-28): the graph lanes (graph, graph-seed) return traversal-shaped evidence — paths, typed edges, and name→path metadata, never record text — so they score zero on passage fidelity by architecture. That zero is the measured difference this lab exists to report, not a bug. The rollup carries both axes — evidence fidelity and judged answers — so the graph lanes' answer quality stands on its own.

unsettled.why: Unbounded exploration under the seeded surface, diagnosed live (event-stream capture, ~4 min / 20 calls): the model resolves the cited records by name, then hunts for a way to read their TEXT — which no seeded tool returns (lookup gives paths + titles; neighbors/paths give edges). Calls repeat within 20 turns (m-003 ×2, d-005 ×2, projects/ledgerline.md ×2) and each turn slows as context grows, so longer leashes do not converge. Measured cost above: 5 attempts, ~5.7 h of agent time. This is the seeded lane's hard failure mode — it fails SLOW on questions whose answer needs record text, where the bare lane failed fast (cold-start lockout → honest refusal in 20 steps). The other 44 seeded cells settled, most inside the suite's 20-minute bound.
